title: Ridgeline Installation Services Measure Booking, Measure Fee and Quote Issue
content:
Every Ridgeline Installation Services contract begins with a measure (or design consultation) booked for one program at one job address.

## Rule

- **Site.** The job site must meet the program's entry requirements, site type and minimum project size, as stated by the customer.
- **Appointment date.** The measure appointment may be no earlier than the program's earliest-appointment figure, in calendar days after the booking date.
- **Fee.** When the program's measure fee is above 0.00, the fee is charged on the booking date as one measure fee line on the contract and is paid at booking. A program whose measure fee is 0.00 offers a free consultation and posts no fee line.
- **Quote.** At the measure the installer issues the installed-price quote. Its quote expiry date is the date the measure was completed plus the program's quote validity days, counted in calendar days. The measure also records whether the job requires a permit.
- **Missed measure.** A customer who misses the measure appointment forfeits the measure fee and must book again.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Booking and measure facts | Program figures used | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Booked on 2 September | earliest appointment 5 calendar days | appointment no earlier than 7 September; 6 September is too early |
| Measure completed on 12 October | quote validity 30 calendar days | quote expiry date 11 November |
| Measure completed on 12 October | quote validity 60 calendar days | quote expiry date 11 December |

## Fee outcomes

| Program measure fee | At booking |
|---|---|
| above 0.00 (for example a hypothetical 35.00) | one measure fee line of that amount, dated the booking date, paid at booking |
| 0.00 | free consultation, no fee line |

**The customer did not attend the measure. Is the fee kept?** The fee is forfeited and the customer books a new measure.
